title: Complete moving checklist
meta_description: Use this checklist to organize dates, inventory, packing, movers, access and tasks before and after the move.
hero_description: A checklist reduces forgetfulness and allows you to distribute tasks into stages, instead of concentrating all the preparation in the last few days.
direct_answer_heading: Break down the move into preparation, hiring, packing and installation
direct_answer: A complete moving checklist should cover the inventory, dates, property access, carrier booking, packing materials, dismantling, box labels, documents, essentials and a final check of both properties. Assign an owner and deadline to each task so you can track progress.
key_points: Set the date and confirm access to both properties.
Create inventory before asking for quotes.
Book the carrier and confirm the service in writing.
Pack and label items by room.
Make a final check before handing over the keys.

sections.heading: Initial planning
paragraphs: Start by defining the date, locations and approximate volume. Separate what will be transported from what will be sold, donated or disposed of.
Record all tasks in a single document and assign a date to each one.
checklist: Check access to the new property.
Separate goods that will not be transported.
Identify heavy, fragile or valuable items.

sections.heading: Choose and confirm the carrier
paragraphs: Submit a complete request and compare equivalent quotes. Confirm the vehicle, team, tasks, date and price.
Keep in writing the chosen quote and the necessary contact details for the day of the move.
checklist: Record date, time and payment conditions.

sections.heading: Prepare materials and packaging
paragraphs: Gather boxes, tape, labels, and protective materials before you begin. Pack the least used items first.
Do not mix fragile items with heavy items and avoid boxes that are difficult to lift.

sections.heading: In the previous week
paragraphs: Confirm that most of the packaging is complete and review the inventory sent to the carrier.
Prepare documents, medicines, keys, chargers and essential items to go with you.
checklist: Prepare a suitcase or box for essentials.
Reserve elevator or access when applicable.

sections.heading: On moving day
paragraphs: Keep corridors clear and indicate items that require greater care. Confirm inventory as you load.
Before leaving, check all rooms, closets, storage rooms, balconies and common areas.
checklist: Keep children and animals away from movement.
Check meters and installations when necessary.
Carry out a final inspection of the property.

sections.heading: After arrival
paragraphs: Confirm that packages have reached their destination and place essential furniture first.
Check for visible damage and report any problems immediately. Do not turn on household appliances before following the precautions applicable to the model.
checklist: Update the address for the necessary services.

mid_cta.heading: Do you already have the moving inventory?
mid_cta.text: Use the information from the checklist to prepare a clear request and compare quotes.
mid_cta.label: Describe the move

faq.question: When should I start the checklist?
faq.answer: As soon as you have a probable date. You can add details as you confirm inventory and services.

faq.question: Do I need to list all items?
faq.answer: List the main furniture, appliances, special items and approximate number of boxes.

faq.question: What should follow with me?
faq.answer: Documents, medicines, valuables, keys, essential equipment and essential items.

faq.question: How to avoid forgetting items?
faq.answer: Carry out the final check by room, including closets, storage rooms, balconies and common spaces.

faq.question: Should I save the carrier's quote?
faq.answer: Yes. Keep the service, value, team, tasks and agreed conditions in writing.
